plugins.name: benaiah
plugins.description: Connect your Telephonist, approve temporary closure updates and review calls, alongside your Benaiah teammates.

skills.name: brief
skills.description: Preview and apply an owner-approved temporary closure or remove a closure on your Telephonist.

skills.name: call-review
skills.description: Review available calls to your connected Telephonist for a chosen local calendar date.

skills.name: delegate
skills.description: Hand an explicitly requested drafting or analysis task to an existing Benaiah teammate and track its saved result. Use when the user asks Benaiah or one of their teammates to continue text work.

skills.name: task-status
skills.description: Find recent Benaiah work and retrieve a task's stored status or result. Use when the user asks what a Benaiah teammate has finished or wants to check delegated work.

skills.name: teammates
skills.description: List the user's existing Benaiah teammates so they can choose who should handle a task. Use when the user asks about their Benaiah team or wants to choose a teammate.

skills.name: telephonist
skills.description: Connect and inspect your Telephonist. Use when choosing a phone service or checking its current state.
